api_doc_gaps.detail: api-docs publishes search, create, update and deactivate for ENT-MDL-001, but NO read by id. The screen therefore resolves its selected type by finding it inside the PAGED `POST /lookup-types/search` result. That was tolerable while the master list and the detail pane shared one route (the row had just been clicked, so it was loaded). It is not tolerable now that the record is its own page (see the SPEC_DEVIATION below): a cold deep link, a bookmark or a browser refresh onto /reference-data/lookups/{id} cannot resolve the record unless that id happens to be on page 0 of the default key-sorted list. Verified live 2026-09-21: creating a type returned id 63 and the record page rendered 'this record is not in the loaded page'. Worked around WITHOUT inventing data: `API-MDL-002` returns the created record, so it is handed to the record page through a Zustand store (`useCreatedTypeHandoff`), and any other unresolvable id renders an honest notice with a link back to the list rather than an empty or fabricated form. Delete that store and the notice when the by-id read is published.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: n/a — container pattern, not an endpoint
api_doc_gaps.detail: The plan gives SCR-MDL-001 the container pattern TREE_MASTER_DETAIL: the type list and the selected type's values on ONE route, with every form in a Drawer. The project owner ruled on 2026-09-21 for a TWO-PAGE master-detail instead: /reference-data/lookups is the list alone; /reference-data/lookups/{id} and /reference-data/lookups/new are record pages whose HEADER FORM IS INLINE, with the values beneath it. Reasons given: the two grids split one viewport so neither had usable height; the selected record was represented only by a highlighted row, so reading or editing its own fields meant opening a Drawer over the values it was selected for. The project's Drawer-first mandate was amended rather than bypassed (CLAUDE.md §3.3, .claude/rules/erp-ui-and-state-mandates.md §2.1, .claude/skills/erp-drawer-zustand §11): a record page is permitted ONLY for a record that owns a child collection; the VALUE add/edit, the filter panel and the confirmations all remain Drawers. This also reverses, in part, the 2026-09-12 owner ruling recorded in lookupsRoutePaths.test.ts that rejected /new and /edit segments — /new is a segment again because it is now a page, while every surface that is still an overlay is still a query param. Needs the factory to restate the container pattern for SCR-MDL-001 before the next version regenerates it as TREE_MASTER_DETAIL.

api_doc_gaps.detail: GAP-MDL-006 (CONTRACT_CHANGE, P2). Observed (erp-core 1.2.0 api-docs): no by-id read of a lookup type is published (search, create, update and deactivate only). Frontend workaround: the /reference-data/lookups/:typeId record page (master-detail, plan v3 step v3-05) resolves the type from the loaded list page; a just-created type is handed over from the 201 body (useCreatedTypeHandoff); a cold link or refresh onto an id outside the loaded page shows an honest notice with Back to the list. (mxdashboard/src/modules/reference-data/features/lookups/hooks/useCreatedTypeHandoff.ts, mxdashboard/src/modules/reference-data/features/lookups/pages/LookupTypeDetailPage.tsx). Backend acceptance: GET /api/v1/mdl/lookup-types/{id} answers 200 with the LookupTypeResponse for an id of the caller's tenant and 404 for an unknown id; the api-docs list it. Same endpoint as the earlier F4 ABSENT entry above (factory phase model); this entry gives it the newfront gap id and backlog item. Backlog: newfront governance/project-artifacts/backend-backlog-erp-core-1.2.0.md#gap-mdl-006
